stories.title: Ravens QB Jackson needs thumb surgery, will be placed on IR
stories.summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson needs to have surgery on his injured right thumb and will be placed on injured reserve, coach Jesse Minter said.

stories.title: Florida State fires Norvell amid seventh season, 3-5 record in '26
stories.summary: Florida State fired Mike Norvell on Sunday, with director of scouting Rick Stockstill taking over on an interim basis.

stories.title: Bucs first team without pass completion since '74, still beat Falcons
stories.summary: Baker Mayfield didn't complete a pass but the Buccaneers beat the Falcons 16-0 behind Bucky Irving and Kenny Gainwell's rushing on a wet, sloppy field.

stories.title: Lions All-Pro Campbell carted off in scary scene, taken to hospital
stories.summary: Lions All-Pro linebacker Jack Campbell was placed on a backboard and carted off the field early in the fourth quarter Sunday against the Vikings.

stories.title: UCLA cracks AP top 5, Ohio State to 11th ahead of first CFP release
stories.summary: Ohio State dropped out of the top 10 of The Associated Press Top 25 for the first time in five years, UCLA entered the top five for the first time in 25 years, and New Mexico earned the first ranking in program history.
